title: Gate every tool call through deny-by-default access checks
narrative: Every tool call — including fused or loop-proposed calls — must pass access control. Uncertain or privileged scopes fail closed. Fangore shows product that a write without grant is refused and that composed packs from `fangore_compound_grants` still apply.
implementation:
Harness tool loops consult `AccessControl` before execution; denied calls emit access-check events and do not run side effects. Failure defaults are deny for mutations / external / privileged / uncertain scope. This story covers tool-gating obligations alongside permission packs.

Covers: GAT-01, GAT-02, GAT-03.
validation: Kind `tool_gating` → `_run_tool_gating`. Soft expects: deny without grant, allow with grant. Related: `tests/test_access.py`, grant_gate story.
